tasks.short: Patrol marine areas and check for pollution

steps.what: Perform marine patrol duties and check for oil spills or other pollutants

tasks.design: The officer patrols and observes the actual marine area, using current instructions in {DOCS}. No new sensing coverage or automatic pollution determination is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pollution and local conditions require direct observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instructions support patrols without removing field presence.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising uncertain signs and deciding when further investigation is needed.
tasks.human_edge: The officer interprets observations in their physical setting.
tasks.altitude: Patrol responsibility and presence stay unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate escalation of observed pollution concerns
reach.learn: Evidence recording and local reporting routes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: patrol and pollution observation remain physical work; no automated marine sensing capability is established by this digest.

assumptions: Boundary is marine patrol and observation, excluding cleanup and separate incident-report drafting.
The responsible operations owner supplies the patrol assignment; the officer produces observations during s1. No free structured pollution flag is assumed.
Use existing native instructions first; runtime earns no labour saving. Zero incremental upkeep because no new patrol tool is introduced.
research_questions: Which pollution concerns require physical investigation beyond available records?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0%. Patrol and direct observation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign crew watches or living quarters

steps.what: Verify crew availability and requirements for watches or living quarters
Arrange candidate watches or quarters within the verified assignment constraints
Resolve conflicts and assign watches or living quarters to crew members

tasks.design: Configure native crew scheduling to propose placements from officer-verified constraints in {HCM} and {CALENDAR}. The officer checks qualification and rest requirements, resolves personal or operational conflicts and communicates the final assignment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine placement can require repeated comparisons of availability and existing assignments.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed constraint checks can prepare candidates without deciding suitability or fairness.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving uncertain availability, individual needs and operational trade-offs.
tasks.human_edge: The officer knows the crew and takes responsibility for a workable assignment.
tasks.altitude: Less routine placement while crew assignment authority remains human.

reach.task: Clarify crew availability and assignment conflicts

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native scheduling can propose placements from explicit crew constraints; no maritime assignment case establishes the proposed saving.

assumptions: Boundary is officer assignment of watches or quarters, excluding standing watches and HR's original qualification administration.

Existing crew administrators supply identities, qualifications and recorded availability. In s1 the officer verifies and captures crew IDs, applicable qualification versions, work/rest history, time windows, required positions, room capacities, existing assignments and relevant crew requests; all clarification and first capture remains in 35%.

The responsible operations owner supplies applicable national, flag and vessel constraints; the officer checks their use in s1. Missing records or personal conflicts remain unassigned for manual resolution in s3; no free structured fit-for-watch flag or worker score is assumed.

Test native crew planning first; existing automatic placement earns no new labour saving. Eight extra focal hours count constraint changes and additional assignment exceptions; 5 other-role hours count crew-data administrator mapping upkeep. New reporting work is not transferred to crew free.
unknowns: Applicable assignment rules and crew-data completeness
Consultation requirements for changed staff-data use
research_questions: Does candidate placement save time after qualification checks, request capture and conflict resolution?

already_counted.description: Crew verification and structured constraint capture
Conflict resolution and final assignment approval

incremental.description: Constraint maintenance and extra assignment exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact crew assignments, time windows, room or watch positions, qualification and constraint versions checked in s3; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+40=75; gross 25%, net 17% after 8 focal upkeep. Range covers existing automated planning with zero gain through 16 points of routine placement removed minus 8 upkeep. Verification and final assignment keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interview and hire crew members after assessing their suitability

tasks.design: The officer interviews candidates and makes the delegated hiring decision using existing records in {HCM} and {DOCS}. No automated suitability score or autonomous offer is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Crew suitability requires contextual judgement and conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support interviews without replacing them.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing practical experience and uncertain evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The officer probes answers and explains the role's expectations.
tasks.altitude: Hiring responsibility and candidate contact stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: crew interviews and hiring decisions remain human; no administrative recruitment baseline is inferred.

assumptions: Boundary is interviewing and the officer's delegated hiring decision, excluding recruitment administration and contract production.
Candidates and existing recruitment staff supply evidence; the officer verifies relevant facts and gathers answers during s1. No structured suitable-candidate flag is assumed.
Test native records first; existing runtime earns no saving. Zero incremental upkeep because no hiring automation is introduced.
unknowns: Officer hiring mandate and national procedures
research_questions: Which candidate evidence needs practical clarification during interview?

already_counted.description: Interview, suitability judgement and hiring approval

approvals.approved_version: Exact candidate, verified evidence, proposed hiring decision and communicated terms checked in s1 within existing authority; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0%. Interview and hiring judgement remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct man-overboard and fire safety drills

steps.what: Conduct safety drills and observe crew responses to the exercise

tasks.design: The officer conducts the physical exercise and debriefs the crew using the approved plan in {DOCS}. Drill observation and practical response are retained rather than replaced by generated completion records.
tasks.previous_blocker: A drill tests coordinated behaviour under practical conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing plans support delivery without removing exercise time.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising misunderstood roles and unsafe habits during practice.
tasks.human_edge: The officer observes responses and adapts feedback to what actually happened.
tasks.altitude: Drill responsibility and presence remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate deck and engine-room exercise responses

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: practical safety drills require human participation and observation; no documentation capability establishes reduced exercise time.

assumptions: Boundary is conducting and debriefing the drill, excluding separate drill-plan authoring and record administration.

The responsible safety owner supplies the existing drill plan. Crew produce exercise responses after instructions during s1 before officer feedback; no structured competence or drill-passed flag is assumed.
Use native document access first; existing runtime earns no saving. Zero incremental upkeep because no new drill tool or assessment process is introduced.
unknowns: Drill requirements and practical exercise format
research_questions: Which response failures become visible only during an actual crew exercise?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0%. Drill delivery and observation retain all time; crew labour is excluded from the focal denominator.

role.altitude: Native assignment candidates may reduce routine placement while patrols, hiring and drills remain human.
reach: Coordinate explicit crew constraints and operational handoffs with vessel staff.
role.ambitious_version: Clearer crew assignments with all qualification checks, personal conflicts and physical duties accounted for.
